title: The Boy and the Hazelnuts
summary: A boy crammed his fist into a jar of hazelnuts and could not pull it out. A bystander advised him to drop half the nuts, and his hand slipped out easily, teaching that moderation b...
full_text: A boy crammed his fist into a jar of hazelnuts and could not pull it out. A bystander advised him to drop half the nuts, and his hand slipped out easily, teaching that moderation brings success.
moral: Take a modest share and succeed; greed traps the hand.
